script_text: Stop, Aquarius—your 1st House opposition could overturn a settled decision. Under whole-sign houses, Pluto, retrograding through your 1st, is in opposition to the Libra Sun in your 9th, exposing tension between identity and public commitments. Air-sign Aquarius is traditionally ruled by Saturn in the 3rd and modernly by Uranus in the 5th, sharpening communication, independence, and bold, original ideas. If single, Jupiter in your 7th attracts warm, proactive partners; Mars trining Pluto from your 4th to 1st makes family encounters feel unexpectedly magnetic. If taken, avoid turning a domestic dispute into a control battle over money or boundaries. A contract involving publishing, foreign clients, travel, or study will likely return for revision; audit the 9th-House deadlines and fine print before signing or funding it. Avoid a rash confrontation; Saturn in the 3rd rewards one calm conversation. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
